chattabs.config.title: Chat Tabs – Settings
chattabs.config.no_tabs: No tabs – add one with “+ New tab”.
chattabs.config.edit.title: Edit tab
chattabs.config.edit.name: Name
chattabs.config.type.tooltip:
System: everything not assigned to a channel or PM tab.
Channel: messages matching the detection (first matching channel wins).
All: shows every message.
chattabs.config.match.tooltip:
Tag: e.g. [G] – prefixes like [Freebuild] before it are skipped.
Contains text: message contains the text anywhere.
Regex: regular expression for experts.
chattabs.config.edit.value.tag.tooltip: The tag messages of this channel start with, e.g. [G]. Server prefixes like [Freebuild] before it don't matter.
chattabs.config.edit.value.regex.tooltip: Regular expression on the message text without colors. Red = invalid.
chattabs.config.edit.info.system: Receives everything no other tab matches.
chattabs.config.prefix.tooltip: Put in front of your message when typing in this tab, e.g. “/g ”. Empty = send normally. Commands (with /) are never changed.
chattabs.config.blink.tooltip: Tab blinks while it has unread messages.
chattabs.config.edit.test.tooltip: Type an example chat line to check whether it would end up in this tab.
chattabs.config.closed.tooltip: Whether the tabs are also shown while the chat is closed. “Only when unread” shows them while a blinking tab has unread messages.
chattabs.config.unread_count.tooltip: Master switch for the unread count after tab names. Per channel under Edit → Counter.
chattabs.config.history.tooltip: How many messages are kept in total (vanilla: 100). All tabs share this storage.
chattabs.config.pm_sound.tooltip: Plays a sound when a private message arrives in a tab that isn't open.
chattabs.config.pm_close.tooltip: Closes all PM tabs when you leave the server.
chattabs.config.pm_command.tooltip: What is sent when you type in a PM tab. {player} = player, {message} = your message, e.g. /msg {player} {message}. Commands (with /) are never changed.
chattabs.config.pm_pattern.tooltip: Regular expression for private messages. The player name is in the group (?<player>…); more alternatives: (?<player2>…), (?<player3>…) etc.
chattabs.config.pm_test.tooltip: Type a private message from the chat to test the detection.
chattabs.config.pm_test.no_match: ✘ Not detected as a private message
chattabs.config.general.title: General
chattabs.config.pm.title: Private messages
chattabs.config.fixed_size.tooltip: The open chat always uses its full height (Chat Settings → Focused Height), so the tabs always stay in the same place.
chattabs.config.channels.title: Channel switching & history
chattabs.config.switch_on_tab.tooltip: When you select a tab, its switch command (e.g. /ch global) is sent to the server so you write in that channel. Set the command per tab under “Edit”.
chattabs.config.hide_confirm.tooltip: Optional: regular expression for the server's reply to the channel switch. Matching messages up to 3 seconds after a tab switch are hidden.
chattabs.config.save_history.tooltip: Saves the messages of all tabs per server and restores them into the right tabs next time you join. “Max history” under General sets how many. Note: if the CubesideMod also saves messages, old messages appear twice.
chattabs.config.delete_history.tooltip: Deletes the saved messages of all servers. The currently visible chat stays.
chattabs.config.history_info: Saved for %s server(s)/world(s), up to %s messages each.
chattabs.config.edit.switch.tooltip: Sent to the server when you select this tab so you write in that channel. Empty = send nothing.
chattabs.config.counter.tooltip: Shows the number of unread messages in brackets after the name, e.g. “Global (3)”. Off = the name just turns yellow.
